name: University of Copenhagen
header:
University of Copenhagen
Denmark · MSc Mathematics; integrated bachelor-to-PhD (3+5); regular post-master PhD
European research-fit addition; distinct academic and employment routes.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• MSc does not waive English testing because of an English-taught UChicago degree.
• The explicit September 2027 PhD call closed November 1, 2026.
• MSc scholarship is competitive, first-priority only; no universal stipend.
• Integrated and regular PhD have different degree and funding structures.
• Schlichtkrull and Nest are emeriti; Esnault is a seasonal visiting professor; old Lars Kühne affiliation is not
current Copenhagen advising evidence.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: a completed or in-progress UChicago mathematics bachelor can be assessed as an international degree.
Required background: at least30 ECTS analysis,22.5 ECTS linear algebra/algebra and15 ECTS
geometry/topology. Supplementation after the bachelor is completed cannot cure missing prerequisites.
Integrated PhD accepts bachelor-level entrants who qualify for the relevant MSc; regular three-year PhD
normally requires the equivalent of a Danish180-ECTS bachelor plus120-ECTS master. F-1 status confers no
Danish fee or immigration exemption. [s1] [s8] [s12] [s17]
Before submission [Standing rule]
For MSc, prepare KU GPA calculator, programme self-assessment and course-description template, English
evidence, verified records and passport; pay the non-EU fee before submission and upload receipt. For
integrated PhD, identify appropriate research supervisors and enter their names; secure admission to the
associated MSc as required by the offer. Do not complete later formal PhD enrollment forms before receiving a
stipend offer. [s2] [s5] [s11] [s12]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
PhD mini-guide strongly advises naming suitable supervisors, who may be first readers; prior contact is useful
but not stated mandatory. MSc does not require prearranged supervision. Grouped faculty below are research
matches, not confirmed 2027 openings. [s11] [s18]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
MSc uses the central application portal with ranked programme choices, required uploads and final acceptance
there. PhD uses the job application portal; initial stipend selection precedes formal graduate-school forms.
Public source does not establish all reference-update controls or receipt states. [s2] [s4] [s8] [s11]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
September 2027 PhD call is explicit and closed; annual MSc dates are standing current rules rather than a
newly dated 2027 notice. English changes from 2026 remain applicable. April 2027 PhD availability,2027
tuition and salary must be checked when new notices appear. [s1] [s3] [s8] [s10]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Standing rule]
MSc non-EU September entry: January 15,23:59CET, portal opens November 15 (standing rule, hence January
15, 2027 planning date). The explicitly advertised September 1, 2027 PhD call closed November 1,
2026,23:59GMT+1. Department also announces a recurring April 1 PhD call, usually posted in February; a
specific April 2027 vacancy and its terms are not yet verified. February MSc intake is for legal-right applicants
and is not the ordinary route from UChicago. [s1] [s4] [s8] [s9] [s10]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
MSc government-scholarship consideration is automatic with timely application and requires this programme
to be your first priority; use January 15. PhD stipend deadline was November 1, 2026, already passed. The later
recurring April 1 round is a prospective route, not a confirmed open 2027 call. [s6] [s8] [s10]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
MSc ordinary checklist does not request references. Current PhD call says references if available, uploaded
with application or emailed by referee to hr-math@adm.ku.dk; no separate receipt grace or fixed number is
stated, so use the call deadline. Later calls may differ. [s2] [s8]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
MSc English proof must be received by the application deadline; a test taken after the deadline is rejected.
TOEFL/IELTS must also remain within two years at September 1 study start. PhD mini-guide allows language
evidence to be revisited after a stipend offer; integrated MSc requirements must still be resolved. No GRE
score deadline is listed. [s3] [s11]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
MSc supporting uploads are due before application deadline; pending-bachelor applicants supply current
certified records. The exact final-degree deadline for a conditional 2027 offer is not established publicly and
must be read in that offer. Current PhD call accepts a certified/signed recent transcript or
institutional/supervisor statement while the qualifying degree is pending. [s2] [s4] [s8]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
MSc standing non-EU schedule: decision by March 13 and acceptance through portal by March 18; the offer’s
stated deadline governs. A later-than-standard offer allows five days. First two semesters of tuition are due
April 15 before September enrollment. PhD response deadline is individual and was not published in the call.
[s4] [s5]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc English B: legacy TOEFL iBT83 overall with20 each, new-scale TOEFL4.5 overall and4.5 each; IELTS
Academic6.5 overall with6 each; Cambridge CAE/CPE180. Accepted versions include TOEFL Home Edition and
IELTS Online; no TOEFL MyBest or IELTS One Skill Retake. TOEFL/IELTS expire after two years measured at
study start; Cambridge does not expire. Upload report or official appointment/TRF identifier for verification. [s3]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
NO for MSc: KU explicitly rejects an English-taught bachelor/master, university medium-of-instruction letter and
native-speaker status as substitutes. It offers no language waiver. Unless you independently hold one of its
listed school-level qualifications, plan a qualifying test. PhD appointment language assessment is separate; do
not assume this removes integrated-MSc requirements. [s3] [s11]

PhD call; no assurance was found that an unsolicited score would be considered. [s2] [s8]

sections.text:
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
MSc: official transcript/degree records with name, ID/date of birth, degree, course names, terms, credits,
grades and grading scale; stamp/signature or verifiable digital record/link/QR required. Include ongoing
courses and previous unfinished-master records where applicable. English records need no translation. PhD:
original bachelor/master diplomas and transcripts plus authorized English translations unless already English or
Danish; certified interim records accepted pending degree. [s2] [s8]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
MSc requires its programme self-assessment mapping bachelor courses/projects to admission requirements
and the KU GPA-calculation sheet. Enter the sheet’s result; a submitted GPA cannot subsequently be changed.
If the grading scale cannot be converted under the instructions, upload the transcript as directed rather than
invent a conversion. [s2]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Required MSc descriptions for relevant completed and ongoing courses: title, topics, completion/expected
date, workload/ECTS or preparation and teaching hours, and textbooks. Use KU template; self-written or
self-translated descriptions are accepted. Save as PDF, filename YourName_Course descriptions, numbering
additional forms. [s2]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
MSc: current reverse-chronological academic CV, PDF, in English/Danish/Swedish/Norwegian; photo
unnecessary, optional official template, no prescribed length/layout. PhD: CV covering education, experience,
publications if any, languages and other relevant skills; current call gives no separate CV page cap. [s2] [s8]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
No ordinary MSc motivation/SOP item listed. PhD: motivated letter, maximum one page. Mini-guide content:
preparation and grades, research interests and reasons for Copenhagen; explain unfamiliar grading scales if
helpful. Exact font, margins and spacing are not prescribed in the checked call. [s8] [s11]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate personal/background essay in the MSc checklist or PhD call. Any relevant context can fit the PhD
motivated letter within its one-page cap. [s2] [s8]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
PhD cover letter and short project-title field communicate interests; name potential supervisors whose work
fits, even if no prior contact. No separate research-interest document is listed. MSc has no such statement in
its standard checklist. [s2] [s8] [s11]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
No separate full proposal requested by the initial 2027 PhD call; later formal PhD project/enrollment paperwork
follows a stipend offer. Enter a short suitable project title. MSc does not request a proposal. [s2] [s8] [s11]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
No thesis, writing sample or paper upload is expressly listed in the ordinary MSc checklist or 2027 PhD call. Do
not assume optional attachments will be read; query the relevant supervisor/HR before adding a large
manuscript. [s2] [s8]
Publications list [Standing rule]
PhD publications, if any, belong in CV. No separate publications-list length or upload-versus-link rule was
published. MSc checklist has no publications item. [s2] [s8]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
MSc: GPA calculator, self-assessment and relevant-course descriptions are separate required uploads; retain all
requested course-level details. PhD: transcripts are required, no additional mathematical-course inventory was
established. [s2] [s8]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
Danish Government Scholarship: no separate essay/form/referee. Consideration uses academic admission
documents and only first-priority applicants. PhD stipend application uses the one-page motivation and CV
already described. [s6] [s8]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
MSc passport/ID scan must show name, birth date, nationality, photograph and expiry. If unavailable, upload
explanation and expected receipt date. Include fee receipt. PhD portal asks degrees, GPAs, research
participation, project title and proposed adviser; precise field character limits and upload sizes were not
verified. [s2] [s11]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
MSc: no universal stipend. SCIENCE government scholarship covers full tuition and22 months of living costs;
monthly cash amount is not published. Government study portal lists mathematics tuition EUR8700/semester,
EUR17400/year, without a 2027-specific guarantee. Integrated PhD before master: up to48 grant portions at
DKK7426 each (2026 rate), plus salary for 150 work hours/year; portions are not a stated48-month payment
schedule. Later salaried phase and regular PhD follow collective agreement; math call does not quote annual
salary. A separate UCPH 2026 PhD ad quotes DKK31800/month plus18.07% employer pension, indicative only,
not a math 2027 guarantee. [s6] [s7] [s8] [s44]
Years of support [Standing rule]
MSc scholarship living component22 months; ordinary degree two years. Integrated PhD up to five full-time
years including MSc, adjusted for prior MSc study; master is completed two years before PhD completion,
followed by two salaried years. Regular post-master PhD is three years. Travel support is included in
departmental stipends, amount unspecified. [s6] [s8] [s12] [s16]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
MSc government scholarship is for non-EU/EEA candidates required to pay tuition and eligible for a Danish
study permit, excluding those entitled to Danish SU. International applicants can compete for PhD
employment/integrated stipends; citizenship is not an advertised exclusion. US F-1 does not replace Danish
permission. [s6] [s8]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
SCIENCE scholarship selection is academic only: first-priority programme and GPA above90% of
maximum;2025 winners had at least98%, not a 2027 guaranteed cutoff. Taxes may apply. PhD requires funded
salary/living costs, tuition and research expenses; central rules prohibit self-paying PhDs from May 2025.
Annual PhD tuition is a funding-budget item, not automatically an additional personal bill. [s6] [s13] [s15]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate government-scholarship application. PhD call is a competitive funded position followed by formal
academic enrollment; integrated candidates must fulfill MSc enrollment conditions. External-funded applicants
are still encouraged to enter the departmental selection process and disclose support. [s6] [s10] [s11] [s12]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
SCIENCE second-year merit scholarships may be awarded after completing60 ECTS by September 1;2025
selection used at least11 on the Danish scale and at most three awards per nationality. Decisions come early
September, with third-semester tuition refunded for recipients. These retrospective criteria are not a promised
2027 entrance award. External doctoral funding must cover all required costs; no self-paying arrangement. [s6]
[s13] [s15]
Application fee [Standing rule]
MSc non-EU application fee DKK1120 (approximately EUR150), once per round for up to three programmes;
pay in DKK before submission and upload receipt for each. Submitted applications are generally not
refundable. Tuition is separate: first two semesters due April 15; third August 15 and fourth January 15 under
the standing schedule. No application charge was found for the employment-based PhD call. [s5] [s8]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
MSc statutory exclusions include qualifying Danish degree or residence status and EU/EEA/Swiss categories.
Ordinary UChicago study/US F-1 and financial hardship do not establish an exemption in the checked rules.
Wrongly charged exempt applicants or unused fee payments may request refund. No general need-based
waiver was verified. [s5]

University of Copenhagen
Denmark · MSc Mathematics; integrated bachelor-to-PhD (3+5); regular post-master PhD
European research-fit addition; distinct academic and employment routes.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• MSc does not waive English testing because of an English-taught UChicago degree.
• The explicit September 2027 PhD call closed November 1, 2026.
• MSc scholarship is competitive, first-priority only; no universal stipend.
• Integrated and regular PhD have different degree and funding structures.
• Schlichtkrull and Nest are emeriti; Esnault is a seasonal visiting professor; old Lars Kühne affiliation is not
current Copenhagen advising evidence.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: a completed or in-progress UChicago mathematics bachelor can be assessed as an international degree.
Required background: at least30 ECTS analysis,22.5 ECTS linear algebra/algebra and15 ECTS
geometry/topology. Supplementation after the bachelor is completed cannot cure missing prerequisites.
Integrated PhD accepts bachelor-level entrants who qualify for the relevant MSc; regular three-year PhD
normally requires the equivalent of a Danish180-ECTS bachelor plus120-ECTS master. F-1 status confers no
Danish fee or immigration exemption. [s1] [s8] [s12] [s17]
Before submission [Standing rule]
For MSc, prepare KU GPA calculator, programme self-assessment and course-description template, English
evidence, verified records and passport; pay the non-EU fee before submission and upload receipt. For
integrated PhD, identify appropriate research supervisors and enter their names; secure admission to the
associated MSc as required by the offer. Do not complete later formal PhD enrollment forms before receiving a
stipend offer. [s2] [s5] [s11] [s12]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
PhD mini-guide strongly advises naming suitable supervisors, who may be first readers; prior contact is useful
but not stated mandatory. MSc does not require prearranged supervision. Grouped faculty below are research
matches, not confirmed 2027 openings. [s11] [s18]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
MSc uses the central application portal with ranked programme choices, required uploads and final acceptance
there. PhD uses the job application portal; initial stipend selection precedes formal graduate-school forms.
Public source does not establish all reference-update controls or receipt states. [s2] [s4] [s8] [s11]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
September 2027 PhD call is explicit and closed; annual MSc dates are standing current rules rather than a
newly dated 2027 notice. English changes from 2026 remain applicable. April 2027 PhD availability,2027
tuition and salary must be checked when new notices appear. [s1] [s3] [s8] [s10]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Standing rule]
MSc non-EU September entry: January 15,23:59CET, portal opens November 15 (standing rule, hence January
15, 2027 planning date). The explicitly advertised September 1, 2027 PhD call closed November 1,
2026,23:59GMT+1. Department also announces a recurring April 1 PhD call, usually posted in February; a
specific April 2027 vacancy and its terms are not yet verified. February MSc intake is for legal-right applicants
and is not the ordinary route from UChicago. [s1] [s4] [s8] [s9] [s10]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
MSc government-scholarship consideration is automatic with timely application and requires this programme
to be your first priority; use January 15. PhD stipend deadline was November 1, 2026, already passed. The later
recurring April 1 round is a prospective route, not a confirmed open 2027 call. [s6] [s8] [s10]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
MSc ordinary checklist does not request references. Current PhD call says references if available, uploaded
with application or emailed by referee to hr-math@adm.ku.dk; no separate receipt grace or fixed number is
stated, so use the call deadline. Later calls may differ. [s2] [s8]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
MSc English proof must be received by the application deadline; a test taken after the deadline is rejected.
TOEFL/IELTS must also remain within two years at September 1 study start. PhD mini-guide allows language
evidence to be revisited after a stipend offer; integrated MSc requirements must still be resolved. No GRE
score deadline is listed. [s3] [s11]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
MSc supporting uploads are due before application deadline; pending-bachelor applicants supply current
certified records. The exact final-degree deadline for a conditional 2027 offer is not established publicly and
must be read in that offer. Current PhD call accepts a certified/signed recent transcript or
institutional/supervisor statement while the qualifying degree is pending. [s2] [s4] [s8]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
MSc standing non-EU schedule: decision by March 13 and acceptance through portal by March 18; the offer’s
stated deadline governs. A later-than-standard offer allows five days. First two semesters of tuition are due
April 15 before September enrollment. PhD response deadline is individual and was not published in the call.

English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc English B: legacy TOEFL iBT83 overall with20 each, new-scale TOEFL4.5 overall and4.5 each; IELTS

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: a completed or in-progress UChicago mathematics bachelor can be assessed as an international degree.
Required background: at least30 ECTS analysis,22.5 ECTS linear algebra/algebra and15 ECTS
geometry/topology. Supplementation after the bachelor is completed cannot cure missing prerequisites.
Integrated PhD accepts bachelor-level entrants who qualify for the relevant MSc; regular three-year PhD
normally requires the equivalent of a Danish180-ECTS bachelor plus120-ECTS master. F-1 status confers no
Danish fee or immigration exemption. [s1] [s8] [s12] [s17]

evidence, verified records and passport; pay the non-EU fee before submission and upload receipt. For
integrated PhD, identify appropriate research supervisors and enter their names; secure admission to the
associated MSc as required by the offer. Do not complete later formal PhD enrollment forms before receiving a
stipend offer. [s2] [s5] [s11] [s12]

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
MSc: no universal stipend. SCIENCE government scholarship covers full tuition and22 months of living costs;
monthly cash amount is not published. Government study portal lists mathematics tuition EUR8700/semester,
EUR17400/year, without a 2027-specific guarantee. Integrated PhD before master: up to48 grant portions at
DKK7426 each (2026 rate), plus salary for 150 work hours/year; portions are not a stated48-month payment
schedule. Later salaried phase and regular PhD follow collective agreement; math call does not quote annual
salary. A separate UCPH 2026 PhD ad quotes DKK31800/month plus18.07% employer pension, indicative only,
not a math 2027 guarantee. [s6] [s7] [s8] [s44]
Years of support [Standing rule]
MSc scholarship living component22 months; ordinary degree two years. Integrated PhD up to five full-time
years including MSc, adjusted for prior MSc study; master is completed two years before PhD completion,
followed by two salaried years. Regular post-master PhD is three years. Travel support is included in
departmental stipends, amount unspecified. [s6] [s8] [s12] [s16]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
MSc government scholarship is for non-EU/EEA candidates required to pay tuition and eligible for a Danish
study permit, excluding those entitled to Danish SU. International applicants can compete for PhD
employment/integrated stipends; citizenship is not an advertised exclusion. US F-1 does not replace Danish
permission. [s6] [s8]

SCIENCE scholarship selection is academic only: first-priority programme and GPA above90% of
maximum;2025 winners had at least98%, not a 2027 guaranteed cutoff. Taxes may apply. PhD requires funded
salary/living costs, tuition and research expenses; central rules prohibit self-paying PhDs from May 2025.
Annual PhD tuition is a funding-budget item, not automatically an additional personal bill. [s6] [s13] [s15]

No separate government-scholarship application. PhD call is a competitive funded position followed by formal
academic enrollment; integrated candidates must fulfill MSc enrollment conditions. External-funded applicants
